observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 40 stand in the right margin and the locator «p. 170.» (L10) in the left margin.

body: the figure stands at the left of lines 24 to 43, which are set beside it in a narrow measure. It is redrawn from measurements of the print: its five circles (the circle ABCD of the half sum of the diameters and the disc of the Sun FKRL about E, and the three discs of the Moon about S, G and Q) and its six straight lines are least-squares fits to the printed ink, and its sixteen letters (bold italic capitals), the dot at G and the four words MERIDIES, SEPTENTRIONES, ORIENS (reading downward) and OCCIDENS (reading upward), in bold sans-serif capitals, stand where they are printed. In SEPTENTRIONES the P is printed broken, with a stroke below it.
body L3, L9: a mark stands under the last e of «quaere» and over the z of the second «azimuth»; they are not signs.
body L15, L36: specks stand under the m of «eadem» and of «centrum»; they are not signs.
body L42: a speck stands before «E»; it is not a sign.
notes_left L2: the dash of «196–7» is printed longer (4.2 pt) than the hyphens of the notes.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
